name: Nooks Call Analytics
description: Nooks AI dialer activity for a sales team: one row per dial with rep, team, sequence and source tool, target account, prospect persona, outcome funnel, objections, callbacks and buying signals. Daily Oct 2024 to Oct 2026.

columns.name: Call ID
columns.desc: Unique dial / call record.

columns.name: Call Date
columns.desc: Date the dial was placed.

columns.name: Rep
columns.desc: Sales rep (SDR/BDR) who placed the dial.

columns.name: Team
columns.desc: Rep's sales team.

columns.name: Rep Tenure
columns.desc: How long the rep has been on the team.

columns.name: Manager
columns.desc: Rep's front-line manager.

columns.name: Call Hour
columns.desc: Local hour of day the dial was placed.

columns.name: Sequence
columns.desc: Sequence / cadence the prospect was dialed from.

columns.name: Sequence Source
columns.desc: Where the sequence lives: Nooks or a connected tool (Outreach, Salesloft, HubSpot).

columns.name: Account
columns.desc: Target account the prospect works at.

columns.name: Account Industry
columns.desc: Industry of the target account.

columns.name: Account Tier
columns.desc: ABM tier of the target account.

columns.name: Persona
columns.desc: Buyer persona of the prospect dialed.

columns.name: Department
columns.desc: Prospect department.

columns.name: Seniority
columns.desc: Prospect seniority level.

columns.name: Prospect Title
columns.desc: Prospect job title.

columns.name: Prospect
columns.desc: Prospect dialed.

columns.name: Buying Signal
columns.desc: Nooks Signals intent trigger on the prospect or account at dial time.

columns.name: Dial Mode
columns.desc: Parallel Dialer, Signal-Based Dialing or Single Dial.

columns.name: Connects
columns.desc: Dials answered by a live person.

columns.name: Conversations
columns.desc: Connects that became a real conversation.

columns.name: Objection
columns.desc: Main objection raised in the conversation.

columns.name: Objections Handled
columns.desc: Objections the rep handled and kept the conversation going.

columns.name: Meetings Booked
columns.desc: Conversations that booked a meeting.

columns.name: Callbacks Requested
columns.desc: Calls where the prospect asked for a callback.

columns.name: Call Outcome
columns.desc: Furthest stage reached: No Answer, Voicemail, Bad Number, Connected, Conversation, Meeting Booked.

columns.name: Talk Time (sec)
columns.desc: Talk time in seconds.

columns.name: Call Score
columns.desc: AI call score (0-100) for conversations.

columns.name: Callback Status
columns.desc: Scheduled, Due Today, Overdue, Completed, Missed or No Callback.

columns.name: Callback Due Date
columns.desc: Date the requested callback is due.

columns.name: Days Overdue
columns.desc: Days past the callback due date (open callbacks only).

columns.name: Dials
columns.desc: Dials placed.

formulas.name: Objections Raised
formulas.desc: Conversations where an objection was raised.

formulas.name: Objection Converted Rate
formulas.desc: Meetings booked after an objection / objections raised.
formulas.expr: sum ( if ( [{T}::OBJECTION_TYPE] != 'None' and [{T}::MEETING_BOOKED_FLAG] = 1 ) then 1 else 0 ) / sum ( if ( [{T}::OBJECTION_TYPE] != 'None' ) then 1 else 0 )

formulas.name: Open Callbacks
formulas.expr: sum ( if ( [{T}::CALLBACK_STATUS] = 'Due Today' or [{T}::CALLBACK_STATUS] = 'Overdue' ) then 1 else 0 )
